summary.ja: 非相互作用軌道と交換相関汎関数で電子密度を自己無撞着に求める。孤立HeはDirac交換のみ、固定周期HeはPySCFによるLDA交換＋VWN5相関の限定例を公開。
summary.en: Solve self-consistently for electron density using noninteracting orbitals and an exchange-correlation functional. The isolated-He example uses Dirac exchange only; the fixed periodic-He PySCF workflow adds VWN5 correlation.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Ground-state nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2 and one doubly occupied spherical 1s Kohn–Sham orbital.
Atomic/molecular examples: p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n and integral p dr=2, with n the total positive electron-number density of both spins.
Atomic/molecular examples: The adopted approximation is E_x[n]=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r, v_x=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), and E_c=v_c=0.
Atomic/molecular examples: The effective field is -2/r+v_H+v_x; second-order radial differences and simple density mixing solve this restricted model.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

next_deliverable.ja: 交換相関モデルを固定した小さな系の実行・検証例。
next_deliverable.en: A small reproducible case with a specified exchange-correlation model.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：厳密汎関数の理論とDirac交換のみという近似を区別する。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybrid、スピン分極、分子、周期バンド計算、励起は未実装。格子収束や独立な同一モデルとの一致は汎関数の物理精度を保証しない。KS固有値を一般の励起エネルギーと同一視しない。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Separate exact-functional theory from the adopted Dirac exchange-only approximation. LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids, spin polarization, molecules, periodic bands and excitations are not implemented. Grid convergence or agreement with an independent implementation of the same model does not establish functional accuracy. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：基底状態・非相対論・孤立He、Z=2。同じ球対称1s Kohn–Sham空間軌道を2電子が占有する。
原子・分子の実行例：p=2|u|²=4πr²n、∫p dr=2。nは両スピンを合わせた正の電子数密度。
原子・分子の実行例：採用近似はE_x[n]=−(3/4)(3/π)¹ᐟ³∫n⁴ᐟ³d³r、v_x=−(3n/π)¹ᐟ³、E_c=v_c=0。
原子・分子の実行例：有効場−2/r+v_H+v_xを、動径2次差分と単純密度混合で解く限定モデル。
固定した1原子単純立方Heセルの周期KS-DFT。PySCFを使う教育用ワークフローで、Γ点／k点、Gaussian軌道基底、FFT補助格子、SCF公差を別々に検査し、同じGTHパラメータ・LDA交換＋VWN5相関のDFTK平面波計算と比較。平衡He結晶や一般物質・金属の検証ではありません。
units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。
boundary_conditions_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：He縮約軌道にu(0)=u(r_max)=0（基本r_max=16 bohr、別途4/8/12/16 bohrの領域検査）。Hartree場は原点で有限、密度の外ではN/rへ接続し、r_maxで0には固定しません。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。

caution.ja: 正確な汎関数の理論と、近似汎関数による実計算を分けます。KS固有値を一般に励起エネルギーと同一視せず、基底状態DFTだけで励起状態まで保証しません。
caution.en: Distinguish exact-functional theory from calculations with approximate functionals. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies; ground-state DFT alone does not guarantee excited-state accuracy.

example_scope.ja: 球対称Heのスピン非偏極・交換のみDirac LDA。相関・GGA・hybrid・分子・周期系・励起は未実装。

New library-backed periodic-He validation is recorded separately.

force_scope.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
force_scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.
